title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — Big Bear Lake, 9–10 October, 2015–2025
claims: For Big Bear Lake on 9–10 October in 2015–2025 there are 22 daily records: daily maximum 12.3–23.9 °C (median 18.9 °C), daily minimum 2.9–13.9 °C (median 8.7 °C), 4 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 1 day with at least 5 mm.
The station is Big Bear Lake village, not the Sugarloaf summit or the high-desert section of the 100M.

verification.note: Daily values retrieved and filtered to 9–10 October; medians and wet-day counts calculated locally.
